messages.subject: Willow - cap strategy
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

C&V have come back at 15% on the general cap (down from our 50%) plus a shorter 18-month limit and a bigger basket. My instinct is we settle the cap around 25% and hold the line on 24 months, conceding the de minimis back to our £42,500 only if they drop the basket back to £425,000. Thoughts before I speak to Tom?

James
